div.head: I Cn 7
div.ab: And we lærað ⁊ biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on his mæges lafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon, þe he sylf ær hæfde;

Ænd we læreð ⁊ biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnan six manna sibba fæce on his agenan cynne æfre ne gewifige, ne on his mæges lafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on his wifes nedmagan, þe he sylf ær hæfde;

⁊ we lærað ⁊ we biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen man binnon six manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne wifige, ne on his mæges leafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on ðæs wifes nydmagan, þe he silf ær hæfde,

Unde commonemus, petimus et in nomine Dei precipimus, ut nemo in parentela sua intra sextam generationem uxoretur, nec in dimissa cognati sui, qui intra sextum geniculum pertineat ei, nec in cognatione uxoris suę;

Hoc quoque rogamus et in nomine Domini pręcipimus, ut nullus Christianus accipiat sibi uxorem infra sextum genu, nec in relicta uxore, quę ita fuit propinquo parenti coniuncta, nec in parente uxoris suę, quam ante habuit;

Docemus etiam et precamur ac in nomine Dei precipimus, ne quis Christianus infra sextum genu in sua cognacione uxorem ducat, neque alienam, cum qua cognatus suus supradicte propinquitatis carnaliter conuersatus est, neque cognatam illius, cum qua ipse rem habuit,

And we lærað ⁊ biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on his mæges lafe þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon þe he sylf ær hæfde;

And we lærað and biddað and on Godes naman beodað þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on his mæges lafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon þe he sylf ær hæfde.

Und wir ermahnen und (wir D) bitten und gebieten in Gottes Namen, dass kein christlicher Mann jemals sich beweibe mit seiner [eigenen] Geschlechts[genossin] innerhalb des Verwandtschaftsabstandes von [nur] sechs Menschen oder mit der Wittwe seines Blutsverwandten, der so nahverwandt gewesen ist, noch mit einer Blutsverwandten des (seines A) Weibes, das er selbst früher gehabt hat;

And we instruct and (we, D) ask and command in God's name that no Christian man ever marry [a woman] of his own kin within the degree of [only] six persons, or the widow of his kinsman who was so closely related, or a blood-relative of the (his, A) wife whom he himself had before;

And we instruct and pray and enjoin, in the name of God, that no Christian man shall ever marry among his own kin within six degrees of relationship, or with the widow of a man as nearly related to him as that, or with a near relative of his first wife's.

And we instruct, pray, and decree in God’s name that no Christian man shall ever take a wife within six degrees of kinship in his own family, nor the widow of one so closely related, nor a close relative of his first wife.

note.seg: Eingangsformel ebenso II 84; ähnlich Cn 1020, 16; inhaltlich vgl. II Cn 51. Mit diesem Kapitel stimmen Hom. n. Wulfstan 271. 308. Sie entbehren die auch Atr, der Quelle, fehlenden Sätze, haben aber mit Cn neahsib, wo VI Atr 12 on woroldcunde sibbe liest. Also folgen sie einem zwischen Atr und Cn stehenden Texte; ebenso u. 7, 2¹. 7, 3¹

Opening formula likewise II 84; similarly Cn 1020, 16; for the content cf. II Cn 51. Hom. n. Wulfstan 271. 308 agree with this chapter. They lack the sentences that are also missing in Atr, the source, but have neahsib in common with Cn, where VI Atr 12 reads on woroldcunde sibbe. They therefore follow a text standing between Atr and Cn; likewise below 7, 2¹. 7, 3¹
‘Knie’ führen Q Inst Cons ein, diese Rechnung mit der nach Sippenfächern vermengend; s. Gl Sippe 12; Eheverbot 6
Q Inst Cons introduce ‘knee’, confusing this reckoning with that by divisions of the kindred; see Gl Sippe 12; Eheverbot 6
in in Inst, statt ‘mit’, übs. unlateinisch on zu wörtlich
in in Inst, instead of ‘with’, translates on too literally, in un-Latin fashion
Auch die einstige Konkubine schliesst Cons aus.—Q braucht pertinere (s. Wb) öfter für ‘verwandt sein’; vgl. Ducange und Nordfrzös. 12. Jhs.: apurtenant
Cons excludes the former concubine as well. — Q often uses pertinere (see Wb) for ‘to be related’; cf. Ducange and Northern French of the 12th cent.: apurtenant
With caps. 7–7, 3, cf. VI Atr. 12 f.
